claim_text: Each organization fits these principles to its own procedures, legacy systems and constraints.
An assistant must be able to confirm a procedure was carried through to the end.
AI support must be able to raise possible safety problems.
AI support must be able to guide a worker in real time while a procedure is under way.
When a workflow changes, the knowledge model carries that change to machines so their picture matches the current workflow.
Encoded procedural knowledge must be queryable, checkable for validity and open to automated reasoning.

section_ref: Why Do I Care About Industrial Processes?
claim_text: One shared body of procedural knowledge serves both human workers and AI consumers.
Procedural knowledge reaches AI systems at run time through an integration that grounds their responses in it.
Adoption runs in order: elicit tacit knowledge, encode it in reasoning-capable structures, then connect it to AI.
The encoding captures the checks and judgments behind a step, not only its one-line instruction.
A single procedure can mix human steps with machine or software steps.
Domain experts stay involved throughout ontology work.
Ontology work reuses existing ontologies wherever possible.
Ontology work is refined through pilot implementations.
